material_type.evidence: Human brain tissues (100 mg) supplemented with complete protease inhibitor cocktail were homogenized in 250 µL of 100 mM ammonium acetate (AA) containing 1 % (w/v) sodium deoxycholate (SDC) for 5 min at high intensity using the tissue homogenizer bullet blender.
